## Proposal and provenance

Stable algorithm slug: `procedural-pattern-distillation`. Source: pm-4k6b note recorded 2026-07-07T15:37:01.799Z.

Cognitive subsystem 8 from pm-vvib. (8) Habit formation / procedural acquisition — the body's procedural memory (plans, templates, profiles, schema) is entirely HAND-AUTHORED; humans additionally acquire procedures implicitly, by repetition. pm mapping: mine the episodic streams for recurring cross-item action sequences by the same author cohort (e.g. create->claim->test link->close-with-resolution->changelog regen, or a recurring triage sequence) and, past a repetition threshold, surface a bounded suggestion to distill the pattern into an authored artifact (template, plan blueprint, or profile) that agents then get served from procedural memory instead of re-deriving the sequence each session. Pure derivation from history streams (n-gram / episode-mining over per-author mutation sequences; the pm-4k6b write-time fold (6) is the natural place to maintain sequence counts) — zero new stored state until a human/agent ACCEPTS the suggestion, at which point the artifact is normal authored data. Distinct from consolidation (episodic->semantic distills FACTS; this distills ACTION SEQUENCES) and from pm-uwfs retrieval practice (which strengthens recall of existing entries; this creates new procedural artifacts). NO daemon per ADR pm-i7i4: counts fold at write time, suggestions render on-demand in context/validate output. Spectrum-neutral: below the repetition threshold (small/young workspaces) the subsystem is silent.

## Delivery boundary

Evaluate this mechanism as a bounded public-SDK experiment before any production adoption. Use the existing scorer and packer contracts; no CLI-only behavior or new command noun. The historical catalog is design input, not evidence that this mechanism was implemented.

## Experiment protocol

Freeze a workspace/history revision and parameter manifest. Compare against the current deterministic SDK baseline using held-out judgments and negative controls. Report nDCG/action success, critical-evidence omission, latency p50/p95, peak memory, tokens per completed task, and rebuild cost separately. Include 3-item/minutes, real-shaped, 100k/1M-item, decades-long, and sparse/dense/imbalanced graph scenarios; smoke subsets may not claim scale acceptance. Bound candidate counts, graph expansions, elapsed time, and output size, with cancellation and completeness receipts. Record exact versus approximate behavior and approximation error; theoretical guarantees require their stated assumptions. Missing or untrusted evidence remains unknown, never inferred proof.

Promotion requires a reproducible quality improvement on the held-out target population, no regression of existing exact invariants or mandatory gates, and a declared compute/token cost justified by that improvement. Reject or defer with the same immutable evidence if those conditions fail. No production default, adaptive learning, or data export is authorized by this planning item.
